content: We evaluated the style transfer itself in the following way. For each pair of sentences, the average score given by three evaluators was calculated, in which the answer that the translated sentence is more formal counts as +1, more informal as -1, and neither as 0. We calculated the root mean square error between these scores and desired values (+1 if we aimed to make the sentence more formal, -1 if more informal). RMSE of 0 would stand for always transferring style in the right direction as judged by all evaluators, and 2 for always transferring style in the wrong direction.
